**THERE IS NO 3X3 AT THIS COMPETITION!**
This competition includes only blindfolded events and big cubes. If you are interested in non-blindfolded events we recommend signing up to the [Speedcubing Australia mailing list](https://speedcubing.org.au/subscribe/) to be notified as new competitions are announced.

Competitors are strongly encouraged to bring a guest who is familiar with the process of judging blindfolded solving.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Whadjuk Nyoongar people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

venue.name: Colégio Asther
venue.address: Rua Frei José de Monte Carmelo 898 – Jardim Paraiso – Campinas-SP

items.information:
## Português

* O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato.
* A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir.

***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 60 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.***

--------------------

## English

* The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab.
* The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition.

***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 60 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.***

You are welcome to join the Facebook Group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).

**Notice of filming and photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:

**¡Bienvenido a los Baja Warm Up!**
En esta emocionante serie de torneos, encontrarás todas las categorías del legendario SpeedCube Baja Open, junto con algunas sorpresas adicionales, diseñadas para encender la pasión y prepararte para el evento más icónico de Baja California. ¡La cuenta regresiva ha comenzado!

Esta es una competencia avalada por la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

**Welcome to the Baja Warm-Up!**
In this thrilling series of tournaments, you’ll find all the categories of the legendary SpeedCube Baja Open, along with some additional surprises, designed to ignite your passion and get you ready for Baja California's most iconic event. The countdown has begun!

This is a WCA-approved competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.name: Swisscubing Cup V 2025
items.information:
Swisscubing Cup V ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus 8 Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, besuche unsere [Website](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2025/). Die Website für den Swisscubingcup 2025 folgt. 

Teilnehmer die sich registrieren aber nicht bezahlen, müssen die Teilnahmegebühr bei ihrer nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen.
______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup V is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of 8 competitions during the whole year. Check out our [website](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2025/) for the details of the other editions. The website for the Swisscubingcup 2025 will follow.

A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.
______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup II fait partie de la Swisscubing Cup 2025, composé de 8 compétitions durant l'année. Jette un oeil sur notre [site web](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2025/) pour plus de détails sur les autres éditions. Le site web de la Swisscubingcup 2025 suivra.

Les compétiteurs qui s'inscrivent et ne viennent pas à la compétition devront payer les frais d'inscriptions à leur prochaine compétition en Suisse.
